preconditions.description: The lengths of strings s and t, and the parameter k must satisfy the given constraints.
The lengths of the input strings s and t must match the specified lengths n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s + t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'No' or 'Yes' followed by two integers representing the starting indices of the cut substrings.

postconditions.expression: any(s[L-1:L+k-1] + s[R-1:R+k-1] == t for L in range(1, n-k+2) for R in range(L+k, n-k+2))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the concatenated substring must contain t as a substring.
